faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Kuvempu University Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Guest Faculty - Environmental Studies post at Kuvempu University is 21st September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the required qualification for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Guest Faculty - Environmental Studies position, candidates must possess a Master's Degree in the relevant subject with a minimum of 55% marks (50% for SC/ST candidates) and have qualified NET/SLET/K-SET.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it along with the required documents via post to the address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Guest Faculty - Environmental Studies at Kuvempu University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for different categories?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 400 for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 250 for SC/ST candidates. Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) are exempted from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. Where is Kuvempu University located?
faq.answer: Kuvempu University is located in Shivamogga, Karnataka, with the pincode 577451.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Guest Faculty - Environmental Studies position is contractual.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an initial application screening followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation provided?
faq.answer: Information regarding age relaxation is not explicitly detailed in the provided data. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for specific details on age relaxation policies.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Kuvempu University, which is www.kuvempu.ac.in.
